newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO rangebound, cash undertone soft.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO rangebound, cash undertone soft.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices were expected to remain rangebound on Tuesday as talks were thin amid a Chinese National Day holiday, traders said.
Cash 180-cst cargoes for loading in October were bid/asked at $115-$118 per tonne on Monday. Traders expected Tuesday's price to hover around Monday's quotes.
Chinese demand has already started to decline, traders said.

They said that the two cargoes sold on Monday at $112.50 and $113 by a US trader to a Japanese trader were expected to be heading to China by October. The cargoes will be lifted from Singapore between October 15-19.
October paper, was bid/asked at $115.50/116.00, lower from Monday's at $115.75/$116.50 on crude losses.
Traders said Mideast supplies and some processing barrels from Okinawa have yet to be sold for October. They said the market may come under pressure in the near term.
